Alger, 5 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L: Algiers, October 5, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Tech manufacturer Huawei has officially opened registrations for the 2026-2027 edition of its international competition, the "Huawei ICT Competition". This contest offers Algerian students the opportunity to measure their digital skills at regional and global levels.
Une opportunité internationale pour les: An international opportunity for Algerian university talents
Organisé chaque année depuis 2015 par Hu: Organized annually since 2015 by Huawei, this tech event is aimed at students and teachers from universities and higher education institutions. It serves as a global platform for learning, exchange, and competition in the information and communication technology (ICT) sector. During the previous 2025-2026 edition, the event gathered over 220,000 participants worldwide.
Pour l'Algérie, rattachée à la zone Afri: For Algeria, attached to the "Northern Africa" zone, the deadline for submitting applications is set for November 30, 2026. The company invites Algerian talents to register to hone their technical skills and take on international challenges.
Des parcours axés sur la pratique et l'i: Tracks focused on practice and technological innovation
La compétition ouverte pour la région Af: The competition open for the Northern Africa region offers specific technical tracks, structured around two main types of contests:
Le concours pratique (\"Practice Competi: The "Practice Competition" evaluates both the theoretical knowledge and technical skills of candidates. It is divided into three specialties: Network, Cloud, and Computing. Beyond theory, candidates are assessed on their practical mastery and ability to work in a team.
Le concours d'innovation (\"Innovation C: The "Innovation Competition" focuses on the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and ICT technologies to solve real-world problems. Participants are encouraged to combine AI, Big Data, Cloud, and the Internet of Things (IoT) to design solutions with a complete technical architecture and commercial application potential.
La procédure d'enregistrement s'effectue: The registration procedure is done online via the official competition platform. Candidates must log in to the "Huawei ICT Competition" portal, select the "Northern Africa" geographical zone, choose the technical track that matches their profile, and fill in the required information to validate their participation before the November 30, 2026 deadline.
